lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Wow! Check out the level of detail on that painting over there! It’s so real, I nearly walked into it!
lines.zh: : 哇！你看那边那幅画的细节！太逼真了，我差点撞上去！

lines.en: : Why does this room smell like chlorine?
lines.zh: : 这房间为什么有股氯的味道？

lines.en: : Hm? Does it? I don’t really smell anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯？有吗？我没闻到什么。

lines.en: : Do you think it could be those fire hydrants? There’s a small leak in one now that I’m looking a little closer at it.
lines.zh: : 你觉得会不会是那些消防栓？我凑近看的话，有一个在漏一点水。

lines.en: : I think it’s the astro-turf. It’s kind of squishy when I step on it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是人造草皮。我踩上去软软的。

lines.en: : Oh, that. Yeah, that’s just how we do it here. I guess I’m just used to the smell.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个。对，我们这儿就是这么弄的。大概是我已经习惯这味道了。

lines.en: : You make astro-turf wet on purpose?
lines.zh: : 你们故意把人造草皮弄湿？

lines.en: : Yes! It’s great for preventing the spread of fires. Which makes me think that hydrant might actually be leaking on purpose. Like an...automatic sprinkler, kind of!
lines.zh: : 对！防火灾蔓延特别有效。所以我觉得那个消防栓可能其实是故意漏的。有点像……自动洒水器那种！

lines.en: : I guess it could be some sort of frog-related issue too, though. I can’t imagine the builders are accustomed to setting up environments in a place as...squishy as this one.
lines.zh: : 不过也可能是什么跟青蛙有关的问题。我想那些建造者也不习惯在这么……软的地方搭环境吧。

lines.en: : Oh! Speaking of that, one of the rumors I heard about this place is that there’s an entire park dedicated to one of the ingredients in marshmallows!
lines.zh: : 哦！说到这个，我听到的关于这地方的传言之一，是这里有一整座公园是专门为棉花糖的其中一种原料建的！

lines.en: : I knew you heard rumors about this place.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你听过关于这地方的传言。

lines.en: : Ah! I mean...no! I just...have an instinctive and strange feeling about the marshmallow park!
lines.zh: : 啊！我是说……不是！我只是……对那座棉花糖公园有种本能的、奇怪的感觉！

lines.en: : I sure hope it’s not full of animal bones...
lines.zh: : 我真希望它里面不是堆满了动物骨头……

lines.en: : Amy, why are you lying to me?
lines.zh: : Amy，你为什么要骗我？

lines.en: : I need you to be honest if we’re going to continue this date.
lines.zh: : 如果我们要继续这次约会，我需要你老实说。
: 我知道，我知道......

lines.en: : I’m afraid you might not want to spend any more time exploring with me if I tell you all I know...
lines.zh: : 我怕要是我把知道的都告诉你，你可能就不想再跟我一起探索了……

lines.en: : I’m having so much fun. And I never want it to end, so...
lines.zh: : 我玩得太开心了。我一点都不想让它结束，所以……

lines.en: : If it’s okay with you, can you please just not ask me about the rumors anymore? You’re not in danger. I promise.
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意的话，能不能别再问我那些传言了？你没有危险。我保证。
: 这也是谎话?
: Amy，别这样。

lines.en: : We’re inside of a sentient creature! Of course you’re in danger! But {i}I’m{/i} in danger too! So those things cancel each other out probably.
lines.zh: : 我们在一个是有知觉的生物体内！你当然有危险！但{i}我{/i}也有危险！所以这两件事大概就互相抵消了。
: 来嘛！我们继续探索！
直走
往左走
往更左边走
